RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 40

An all-male panel does not prove discrimination, but it increases the risk of unconscious affinity bias and may violate civil service diversity guidelines. 

A two-week delay for feedback is common in government bureaucracies. Follow up politely on your request first. Once received, examine whether the successful candidate's international project experience legitimately aligned with published criteria or if standards were applied inconsistently. 

If the feedback is evasive, the scoring appears arbitrary, or internal rules require gender-balanced panels, consult your union or HR representative. Raising the issue as a procedural breach or asking how panel diversity was ensured is generally safer and more effective than directly alleging sex discrimination without documented evidence.
